summary: Six-level effort slider; reaching Ultracode bursts and grows a trail of light behind the thumb. Form-associated.

attributes.name: value
attributes.type: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultracode
attributes.description: Selected level. Observed and reflected; a value set by markup or code is also the level a form reset restores. An unknown value on connect selects `ultracode`; unknown values set later are ignored.

attributes.name: recommended
attributes.type: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultracode
attributes.description: Level marked `Recommended` under the track. Any other value hides the marker. Observed.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. The slider ignores pointer and keys and leaves the tab order; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same. A disabled slider is not submitted.

events.name: input
events.detail: { value: string, index: number, label: string }
events.description: Fires each time the level changes during a drag or key press. `label` is the display name.

events.name: change
events.detail: { value: string, index: number, label: string }
events.description: Fires when a level is committed on pointer release or key press, if it differs from the last committed level.

events.name: ultracode
events.description: Fires when the thumb settles on Ultracode after arriving from another level, including programmatic changes.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected level id. Setting it writes the attribute.

accessibility: The track has `role="slider"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-label="Effort"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="5"`, `aria-valuenow` as the level index and `aria-valuetext` as the level name.
The level name in the header is `aria-hidden`.
While disabled, the track has `aria-disabled="true"` and `tabindex="-1"`.
motion: With reduced motion the thumb jumps, there is no burst or sparks, the Ultracode trail is drawn once without moving pulses, and the level name swaps without rolling or shimmer.
form: Submits the level id, for example `high`, under `name`. No validation. Form reset restores the level from the `value` set by markup or code; a disabled slider is not submitted.
notes: Levels are fixed: Low, Medium, High, Extra (`xhigh`), Max and Ultracode.
The canvas extends 30px above and below the track and 8px to each side.
